claims.statement: Sony US18650VTC4 is documented as a flat-top, unprotected 18650 cell; the specification records approximately 18.2 mm x 65.0 mm and common retail references show a green wrapper for this model.
Steam Engine preserves Sony US18650VTC4 2100mAh 30A as a 2100mAh preset with a 30A runtime rating.
Battery Mooch assessed this tested exact model at 23A continuous discharge.
Murata identifies the Sony/Murata US18650VTC4 positive electrode as NCM, with graphite as the negative electrode.
The exact catalog entry Sony US18650VTC4 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2016-03-14 or earlier.
